note: Public US list prices for monthly billing, per account unless billing is per_seat. verified=true means the price was read on the provider's own pricing page on as_of; verified=false means it comes from secondary sources and should be confirmed. No provider API reports what a plan costs; override per credential in settings for annual, regional, or team pricing.

max_5x.name: Claude Max 5x
max_5x.note: Pricing page lists Max "From $100 per month"; 5x is the entry tier.

max_20x.name: Claude Max 20x
max_20x.note: The pricing page names the 20x tier without stating its price; $200 is the long-standing list price.

team_standard.name: Claude Team (standard seat)
team_standard.note: $25 per seat billed monthly; $20 billed annually.

team_premium.name: Claude Team (premium seat)
team_premium.note: $125 per seat billed monthly; $100 billed annually.

plus.name: ChatGPT Plus
plus.note: chatgpt.com/pricing returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches; price from secondary sources.

prolite.name: ChatGPT Pro (5x)
prolite.note: The $100 Pro tier reported since April 2026; Codex reports it as plan_type prolite. Secondary sources only.

business.name: ChatGPT Business
business.note: Standard seat, billed monthly ($20 billed annually), repriced in April 2026 per secondary sources.

team.name: ChatGPT Team (now Business)
team.note: Team was renamed Business; same price. Kept for credentials that still report plan_type team.

supergrok.name: SuperGrok
supergrok.note: x.ai returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches. Secondary sources report existing subscribers keep this price after xAI's October 2026 move to an X Subscription for new sign-ups.

supergrok_heavy.name: SuperGrok Heavy
supergrok_heavy.note: Secondary sources only; see the supergrok note.

pro.name: Google AI Pro
pro.note: The Google One plans page renders prices client-side and was not readable; secondary sources.

ultra-lite.name: Google AI Ultra (5x)
ultra-lite.note: Assumes Antigravity's g1-ultra-lite-tier is the 5x Ultra plan. Secondary sources.

ultra.name: Google AI Ultra (20x)
ultra.note: Assumes Antigravity's g1-ultra-tier is the 20x Ultra plan; it replaced the single $249.99 Ultra plan in 2026. Secondary sources.

teams.name: Devin Teams
teams.note: $80/month for the team plan plus $40/month per full developer seat.
